title: Linguistically-Aligned and Visually-Grounded Preference Optimization for Clinically-Augmented Medical Report Generation
summary: Despite significant advances in Medical Report Generation (MRG), the reliability remains constrained by the prevalence of factual errors. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a promising post-training paradigm to enhance the performance of Supervised Fine-Tuned (SFT) MRG models, existing DPO-based MRG methods typically adopt a naive preference construction that directly pairs model-generated reports with ground truth reports. This strategy inadvertently entangles critical clinical findings with clinically irrelevant linguistic characteristics, and fundamentally lacks explicit vision-language alignment. To address these challenges, we propose DPO-Clin, a novel post-training framework that focuses preference optimization on clinical findings and cross-modal alignment. First, we introduce the Entity-level Clinical Diagnostic (ECD) module to perform a precise entity-level factual diagnosis. ECD guides the generation of linguistically-aligned report preference pairs, isolating clinical discrepancies from linguistic variations. Second, to achieve fine-grained cross-modal alignment, we develop M$^2$DPO, a retrieval-augmented multi-modal DPO variant that enforces textual preference inversion triggered by visual context switches. Third, we locate correct yet highly uncertain predicted entities and apply counterfactual modifications to construct targeted preference data for latent risk mitigation, thereby further enhancing the model reliability. Extensive experiments on two public chest X-ray datasets (MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray) and an in-house endoscopy dataset demonstrate that DPO-Clin significantly improves the SFT baselines on clinical-aware metrics. Furthermore, it achieves superior performance over existing DPO-based MRG methods, exhibiting robust generalizability across distinct baseline architectures and diverse medical imaging modalities.
tldr: This paper proposes DPO-Clin, a post-training framework for medical report generation that enhances factual accuracy by focusing preference optimization on clinical findings and cross-modal alignment, using entity-level diagnosis and a multi-modal DPO variant, achieving superior results on chest X-ray and endoscopy datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DPO-Clin，一种用于医学报告生成的后训练框架，通过将偏好优化聚焦于临床发现和跨模态对齐，利用实体级诊断和多模态DPO变体，在胸部X光和内窥镜数据集上取得了更优的结果。
summary_zh: 尽管医学报告生成（MRG）领域取得了显著进展，但其可靠性仍受到事实错误普遍存在的制约。尽管直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为一种有前景的后训练范式，用于提升经过监督微调（SFT）的MRG模型的性能，但现有基于DPO的MRG方法通常采用一种朴素的偏好构建方式，直接将模型生成的报告与真实报告配对。这种策略不经意地将关键的临床发现与临床无关的语言特征纠缠在一起，并且从根本上缺乏明确的视觉-语言对齐。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了DPO-Clin，一种新颖的后训练框架，将偏好优化聚焦于临床发现和跨模态对齐。首先，我们引入了实体级临床诊断（ECD）模块，以执行精确的实体级事实诊断。ECD引导生成语言对齐的报告偏好对，将临床差异与语言变异分离开来。其次，为实现细粒度的跨模态对齐，我们开发了M$^2$DPO，一种检索增强的多模态DPO变体，它强制实现在视觉上下文切换时触发的文本偏好反转。第三，我们定位正确但高度不确定的预测实体，并应用反事实修改来构建针对性的偏好数据以减轻潜在风险，从而进一步增强模型可靠性。在两个公开胸部X光数据集（MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray）以及一个内部内窥镜数据集上进行的大量实验表明，DPO-Clin在临床相关指标上显著提升了SFT基线。此外，它优于现有的基于DPO的MRG方法，在不同的基线架构和多种医学影像模态中展现出鲁棒的泛化能力。

title: Agentic AI-powered flexible fiber-bundle endoscopy for high-resolution NIR-II fluorescence imaging in vivo
summary: Fiber-bundle endoscopy offers a compact and flexible route for clinical fluorescence imaging through natural human orifices, but since its first report in the 1950s, it has remained limited by low spatial resolution, honeycomb artifacts, and inter-core crosstalk. The crosstalk becomes more pronounced at near-infrared-II wavelengths (NIR-II, 1000-3000 nm), a spectral window that offers superior contrast, resolution, and tissue penetration depth for biomedical imaging. Here, we present an AI-powered flexible endoscopy platform that overcomes these constraints through optical-computational co-design: optimizing ultrathin fiber bundles to mitigate crosstalk-induced image blur and enable high-fidelity image transmission across the visible-to-NIR-II spectral range, and developing an Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) pipeline for honeycomb-artifact removal and image restoration. GAME provides a single restoration entry point for diverse biomedical images acquired with our endoscope, spanning cell, mouse and human samples. It dynamically routes each input to suitable restoration experts via a vision-language model, facilitating image reconstruction with a fourfold resolution improvement beyond the NyquistShannon sampling limit. The utility of our endoscope is demonstrated through in vivo NIR-II imaging of anatomical structures in mice, as well as imaging of the digital micromirror device (DMD)-projected human gastric tube and lymphatic system, paving the way for future clinical translation.
tldr: This paper presents an AI-powered flexible fiber-bundle endoscopy platform that overcomes long-standing limitations of low resolution, honeycomb artifacts, and crosstalk in NIR-II imaging, using optical-computational co-design and an Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) pipeline to achieve fourfold resolution improvement beyond the Nyquist-Shannon limit.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于AI的柔性光纤束内窥镜平台，通过光学计算协同设计和智能引导混合专家（GAME）流水线，克服了NIR-II成像中长期存在的低分辨率、蜂窝伪影和串扰问题，实现了超越奈奎斯特-香农极限四倍的分辨率提升。
summary_zh: 光纤束内窥镜为通过人体自然腔道进行临床荧光成像提供了一条紧凑且灵活的途径，但自20世纪50年代首次报道以来，其应用始终受限于低空间分辨率、蜂窝伪影及纤芯间串扰。在近红外二区波长（NIR-II，1000–3000 nm）——这一能为生物医学成像提供更高对比度、分辨率和组织穿透深度的光谱窗口——下，串扰现象尤为显著。本文提出一种基于人工智能的柔性内窥镜平台，通过光学-计算协同设计克服上述限制：优化超薄光纤束以减轻串扰导致的图像模糊，实现可见光至NIR-II波段的高保真图像传输；并开发基于智能体引导的混合专家（GAME）流水线，用于去除蜂窝伪影及图像复原。GAME为利用该内窥镜获取的多种生物医学图像（涵盖细胞、小鼠及人类样本）提供了统一的复原入口，通过视觉语言模型将各输入动态路由至合适的复原专家，从而在奈奎斯特-香农采样极限基础上实现四倍分辨率提升的图像重建。我们通过小鼠解剖结构的活体NIR-II成像，以及对数字微镜器件（DMD）投影的人体胃管和淋巴系统的成像，展示了该内窥镜的实用性，为未来临床转化铺平了道路。

title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning
summary: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.
tldr: MedCalc-R1 introduces a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework for reinforcement learning in medical mathematical reasoning, using a knowledge verification mechanism and a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme to overcome the limitations of tolerance-based rewards in clinical scenarios.
tldr_zh: MedCalc-R1提出了一个知识引导的混合奖励框架，用于医学数学推理中的强化学习，通过知识验证机制和混合软硬奖励方案克服了临床场景中基于容差奖励的局限性。
summary_zh: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）框架中，数学推理任务通常采用基于容差的奖励机制来评估浮点结果。然而，该策略面临阈值校准困难、训练动态不稳定以及精度受限等挑战，尤其在临床场景中更为突出。为克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种知识引导的混合奖励框架（\textsc{MedCalc-R1}）。具体而言，我们引入了一种知识验证奖励机制，强制显式生成计算公式，并通过外部验证器进一步验证，以增强可解释性和推理可靠性。此外，我们设计了一种混合软硬奖励方案，将基于临床安全阈值的硬约束与渐进引导学习在可接受范围内的软精度敏感奖励相结合。实验结果表明，我们的方法在推理准确性和泛化能力上均显著优于现有基线，验证了其在安全关键领域的有效性和适用性。

title: Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation
summary: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates various vision encoders, token-reducing projectors, and LLMs for 3D CT radiology report generation, finding that anatomy-guided region cropping consistently improves clinical F1 and that resolution benefits are projector-dependent, achieving state-of-the-art results on two datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了多种视觉编码器、令牌缩减投影仪和LLM在3D CT放射报告生成中的表现，发现解剖引导的区域裁剪能稳定提升临床F1，分辨率提升的效果取决于投影仪类型，在两个数据集上达到了最先进水平。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型为自动化放射学报告生成提供了一条有前景的路径，但将其应用于完整的三维CT体积会带来巨大的计算挑战。现代基础视觉编码器每次扫描可产生数万个视觉标记，这使得传递给大语言模型的视觉序列成为首要计算瓶颈。视觉到语言投影器可以压缩该序列以减少计算量，但可能会丢弃临床相关细节；相反，有效的压缩可以在保持下游令牌数量固定的同时容纳更高分辨率的输入。因此，如何将这一视觉令牌预算分配到输入视场、空间分辨率和视觉到语言投影上，仍然是一个开放的设计问题。我们在两个大规模CT报告数据集（CT-RATE和Merlin）上，系统评估了四种异构视觉编码器（基于CNN和ViT）、五种令牌缩减投影器（压缩倍数高达64倍，并设置非缩减MLP投影器作为基线）以及五种指令微调大语言模型（参数量1.7B至4B）。在匹配的LLM令牌预算下，基于解剖结构的感兴趣区域裁剪是最一致的策略，在20种设置中的19种中改善了临床宏F1：对于3D ViT Primus编码器平均提高3.7个点，对于基于切片的2D ViT Curia编码器平均提高1.1个点。进一步提升输入分辨率高度依赖于投影器：PerceiverResampler与更高分辨率的Curia特征结合，在两个数据集的分辨率研究中均取得了最强配置。我们的最佳配置在测试集上达到了临床宏F1的最新水平，在CT-RATE上达到49.5，在Merlin上达到49.0。代码和模型将在论文发表后公开。

title: A Distribution Mapping Approach to Counterfactually Fair Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to optimize sequential decisions to maximize population-level benefits over time. However, when deployed in high-stakes settings such as healthcare, RL decisions might systematically restrict some subpopulation's access to valuable services in a manner contrary to the values and goals of stakeholders. Counterfactual fairness (CF) offers a promising framework to address this problem based on causal reasoning. This paper develops a data preprocessing algorithm that, when used in tandem with policy learning, enables CF in RL. Our algorithm relies on a novel quantile distribution mapping method for sequentially estimating the counterfactual states and rewards in the data preprocessing step, subsuming common additivity assumptions used for counterfactual prediction as a special case. We theoretically prove that the per-step level of counterfactual unfairness and infinite-horizon suboptimality gap can be bounded under mild regularity conditions. We also empirically test our algorithm in numerical experiments as well as in application to a real-world interventional digital health dataset.
tldr: This paper proposes a data preprocessing algorithm based on quantile distribution mapping to achieve counterfactual fairness in reinforcement learning, with theoretical bounds and empirical tests on a digital health dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分位数分布映射的数据预处理算法，用于在强化学习中实现反事实公平性，给出了理论界并在数字健康数据集上进行了实证测试。
summary_zh:
摘要：
强化学习旨在优化序贯决策，以最大化随时间推移的群体层面收益。然而，当部署于医疗等高风险场景时，强化学习决策可能系统性地限制某些子群体获取有价值服务的机会，这与利益相关者的价值观和目标相悖。反事实公平基于因果推理，为解决该问题提供了一个有前景的框架。本文开发了一种数据预处理算法，该算法与策略学习结合使用时，能够在强化学习中实现反事实公平。我们的算法采用一种新颖的分位数分布映射方法，在数据预处理步骤中依次估计反事实状态与奖励，并将常用的反事实预测可加性假设作为其特例。我们理论上证明，在温和正则条件下，每步的反事实不公平程度以及无限时域次优性差距均可被界定。此外，我们还在数值实验及真实世界介入性数字健康数据集的应用程序中，对算法进行了实证检验。
